_source_of_truth: The 20 sheets, read by 02-product/prototype/build_prototype.py and 04-launch/landing/build.py. Edit here, then re-run both builds. The prose rationale for each sheet lives in 20-sheet-content-plan.md.
_verification: Every fact below is a DRAFT awaiting the independent cultural and editorial review. Nothing prints unverified.

sheets.art: A single oryx in profile on open ground, long straight horns, generous unbroken body shapes for young hands. Low dunes suggested behind, not detailed.
sheets.fact_ar: المها العربي لونه أبيض، ويعكس ضوء الشمس ليبقى بارداً في الحر.
sheets.fact_en: The Arabian oryx is white — its pale coat reflects sunlight and helps it stay cool.
sheets.make_en: Draw it a friend
sheets.verify: Coat and heat description; conservation story if used in copy elsewhere.

sheets.art: Three date palms of different heights, heavy date bunches, a low basket at the base. Fronds drawn as separable strokes a child can color one by one.
sheets.fact_ar: في السعودية أنواع كثيرة من التمر، منها السكري والعجوة والخلاص.
sheets.fact_en: Saudi Arabia grows many kinds of dates — among them Sukkari, Ajwa and Khalas.
sheets.make_en: Color each bunch a different color
sheets.talk_ar: أي نوع تمر تحبون في البيت؟
sheets.talk_en: Which dates does your family like best?
sheets.verify: Variety names and spellings.

sheets.art: A dense grove seen from within — palms overhead, a water channel through the foreground, small figures walking. Depth without perspective tricks.
sheets.fact_ar: واحة الأحساء من أكبر الواحات في العالم، وفيها ملايين النخلات.
sheets.fact_en: Al-Ahsa is one of the largest oases in the world, with millions of palm trees.
sheets.make_ar: ما الذي يعيش في الماء؟ ارسمه
sheets.make_en: What lives in the water? Draw it
sheets.verify: Oasis scale claim and UNESCO World Heritage listing wording.

sheets.art: The escarpment edge in strong horizontal bands of rock, a tiny figure standing safely back from the drop for scale, wide empty sky above.
sheets.fact_ar: هذه الصخور كانت يوماً تحت البحر، قبل ملايين السنين.
sheets.fact_en: These rocks were once under the sea, millions of years ago.
sheets.make_en: Give every rock layer its own color
sheets.verify: PRIORITY — the marine-origin geology claim for the Tuwaiq escarpment. Most likely fact here to be over-simplified into something wrong.

sheets.art: Dense coral heads and fish filling the whole sheet. The busiest page in the pad, deliberately — the reward page for a child who wants to spend a long time.
sheets.fact_ar: الشعاب المرجانية بيوت حيّة، تعيش فيها آلاف الأسماك.
sheets.fact_en: Coral reefs are living homes where thousands of fish shelter.
sheets.make_en: Add a fish that you invent
sheets.verify: That corals are described as living animals correctly for this age.

sheets.art: Shoreline with mangroves, wading birds mid-step, one gazelle at the treeline.
sheets.fact_ar: تتوقف الطيور المهاجرة في جزر فرسان لترتاح في رحلتها الطويلة.
sheets.fact_en: Migrating birds stop to rest in the Farasan Islands on their long journey.
sheets.make_ar: من أين جاء هذا الطائر؟ ارسم طريقه
sheets.make_en: Where did this bird come from? Draw its path
sheets.talk_en: Where does your family travel together?
sheets.verify: Which species to depict; the Farasan gazelle's status and whether to name it.

sheets.art: A rose bush in bloom in the foreground, terraced fields behind, two hands picking a single flower into a basket.
sheets.fact_ar: يُقطف ورد الطائف مبكراً في الصباح، حين تكون رائحته أقوى.
sheets.fact_en: Taif roses are picked early in the morning, when their scent is strongest.
sheets.make_en: How many roses can you color?
sheets.verify: Harvest timing and season.

sheets.art: Stacked stone tower-houses rising up the slope, white quartz lines banding each storey, small windows in rhythm. Strongly geometric.
sheets.fact_ar: بيوت رجال ألمع مبنية بالحجر، وتزيّنها خطوط بيضاء من المرو.
sheets.fact_en: The houses of Rijal Almaa are built of stone, banded with white quartz lines.
sheets.make_en: Design a new window for one house
sheets.verify: Construction materials and the quartz banding description.

sheets.art: One tall facade in Historic Jeddah, three storeys of carved wooden roshan bay windows filling the sheet — the single best pattern page in the pad.
sheets.fact_ar: الرواشين نوافذ خشبية تُدخل الهواء وتحفظ خصوصية البيت.
sheets.fact_en: Rawasheen are carved wooden windows that let air in and keep the home private.
sheets.make_en: Give every roshan a different pattern
sheets.talk_en: What can you see from your window?
sheets.verify: Singular/plural (روشان / رواشين), the function description, UNESCO listing wording.

sheets.art: Najdi mud-brick walls with triangular openings, stepped parapets, palms behind. Warm, solid, simple masses.
sheets.fact_ar: بُنيت الدرعية بالطين، والجدران السميكة تبقي البيت بارداً.
sheets.fact_en: Diriyah was built from mud brick — thick walls keep a house cool inside.
sheets.make_en: Draw what is behind the door
sheets.verify: At-Turaif spelling and UNESCO listing wording; construction description.

sheets.art: One free-standing sandstone tomb facade carved into rock, desert floor, a bird on the crown for scale.
sheets.fact_ar: نُحتت هذه الواجهات في الصخر قبل أكثر من ألفي سنة.
sheets.fact_en: These faces were carved into solid rock more than two thousand years ago.
sheets.make_en: Color the rock in sunset colors
sheets.verify: The age claim, Nabataean attribution, and whether to name Qasr al-Farid specifically.

sheets.art: An interior wall covered in geometric Asiri painting, a woman's hand at the edge mid-stroke. Pure pattern — the child completes the wall. MOTIFS MUST COME FROM GENUINE REFERENCE, NEVER INVENTED.
sheets.fact_ar: القط العسيري فن ترسمه النساء على جدران البيوت في عسير.
sheets.fact_en: Al-Qatt Al-Asiri is a wall-painting art made by women in the Asir region.
sheets.make_en: Finish the pattern in your own colors
sheets.verify: HIGHEST PRIORITY. Attribution to Asir and to women artists must be exact; motifs drawn from genuine reference, not invented; confirm UNESCO intangible-heritage wording before any marketing use.

sheets.art: A ground loom with a partly-woven band, the geometric pattern running off the sheet edge so the child continues it. Reference-based motifs only.
sheets.fact_ar: السدو نسيج من صوف الغنم والإبل، بأشكال هندسية متوارثة.
sheets.fact_en: Sadu is weaving made from sheep and camel wool, in geometric patterns passed down.
sheets.make_en: Continue the weaving with your own pattern
sheets.talk_ar: من في عائلتكم يصنع شيئاً بيديه؟
sheets.talk_en: Who in your family makes things by hand?
sheets.verify: Materials, the transmission description, UNESCO intangible-heritage wording.

sheets.art: A workbench: clay pots at three stages, coiled khoos baskets and mats, hands working. A making page rather than an object page.
sheets.fact_ar: من سعف النخل تُصنع السلال والحصر والمراوح.
sheets.fact_en: Palm fronds are woven into baskets, mats and fans.
sheets.make_en: What will you put in the basket? Draw it
sheets.verify: The term خوص and the list of woven objects.

sheets.art: A dallah, small handleless finjan cups arranged on a tray, a dish of dates beside them.
sheets.fact_ar: تُقدَّم القهوة العربية للضيف أولاً، وهي من عادات الكرم.
sheets.fact_en: Arabic coffee is offered to the guest first — part of the custom of welcome.
sheets.make_en: Draw who will drink with you
sheets.verify: Serving custom described accurately and without over-generalising; UNESCO wording.

sheets.art: Market stalls across the full width — spices in open sacks, fabric bolts, brass and baskets, shoppers of different ages. The most detailed everyday-life page.
sheets.fact_ar: في السوق تُباع البهارات بالوزن، ولكل واحد رائحة تعرفه.
sheets.fact_en: At the souq, spices are sold by weight — and each one has a smell of its own.
sheets.make_en: Add a new stall to the market
sheets.talk_en: What do you usually shop for together?
sheets.verify: Depictions of dress and setting are contemporary and not caricatured.

sheets.art: A falcon at rest on a gloved hand, wings folded, in profile. Sky behind, a second falcon in flight small in the distance.
sheets.fact_ar: الصقر من أسرع الطيور، ويتدرب على يد صاحبه بصبر طويل.
sheets.fact_en: The falcon is among the fastest birds, and is trained by its keeper with long patience.
sheets.make_ar: ارسم ما يراه الصقر من الأعلى
sheets.make_en: Draw what the falcon sees from up high
sheets.verify: Speed claim, training description, UNESCO intangible-heritage wording.

sheets.art: A contemporary city skyline in clean geometric masses, a metro train crossing the foreground, trees and people at street level. Modern, lived-in, not a postcard.
sheets.fact_ar: الرياض مدينة تكبر بسرعة، وفيها قطار يمرّ تحت الأرض وفوقها.
sheets.fact_en: Riyadh is a fast-growing city, with a train that runs both under and above the ground.
sheets.make_en: Design a new building for the city
sheets.verify: Metro description current at time of print.

sheets.art: Two astronauts floating inside a station module, Earth through the window with the Arabian Peninsula visible below.
sheets.fact_ar: في عام ٢٠٢٣ سافر رائدا فضاء سعوديان إلى محطة الفضاء الدولية.
sheets.fact_en: In 2023, two Saudi astronauts travelled to the International Space Station.
sheets.make_en: What would you see from the window? Draw it
sheets.talk_ar: ماذا تحب أن تكون حين تكبر؟
sheets.talk_en: What would you like to be when you grow up?
sheets.verify: The 2023 mission facts, and whether to name the astronauts on the sheet — naming real living people needs a deliberate decision, not a default.

sheets.art: A decorated empty frame — a border drawn in motifs echoing sheets 12 and 13 — and nothing inside it. Design the border so a phone photo of a finished sheet looks good with no cropping.
sheets.fact_ar: لكل واحد منّا سعوديته التي يراها. ارسم سعوديتك أنت.
sheets.fact_en: Everyone sees their own Saudi Arabia. Draw yours.
sheets.make_en: This page is yours
sheets.verify: Arabic phrasing reads naturally to a child.
